title: Byte Unpack
text: Convert uint8 vector to input signals, 1 input, 1 output; {Output port dimensions (cell array)} sets the dimensions of block output signals, {Output port data types (cell array)} sets the data types of block output signals and {Byte Alignment} sets the byte boundary for data type alignment. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Converted signal data signal of type double (default) | array of signal data

params.name: Output port dimensions (cell array)
params.values: Dimensions of block output signals {[1]} (default) | cell array of data dimension specifications

params.name: Output port data types (cell array)
params.values: Data types of block output signals {’double’} (default) | cell array of Simulink data types

params.name: Byte Alignment
params.values: Byte boundary for data type alignment 1 (default) | 2 | 4 | 8
